title: Test provider handoff attachment on both claim paths
description: Add flat-file provider tests showing task next and explicit task start return all retained handoffs targeted to the claimed task in newest-first order, exclude global and other-task records, and return the same records again when a paused task is reclaimed because reads are non-consuming. Prove a corrupt handoff store prevents any status, assignee, or timestamp mutation. Confirm pause/done and ordinary reads do not attach handoffs.
